en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, raising it,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no goodness in neglecting the Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that there is nothing of goodness in neglecting al-Hajj.”
